_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Objects.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

Albacore_Description.english: Likes the "borders" of temperature, meaning the places where cold water and warm water meet.

AmaranthSeeds_Description.chinese: 秋天播种。7 天成熟。用镰刀收获。
AmaranthSeeds_Description.english: Sow in autumn. Matures in 7 days. Harvest using a scythe.

Amaranth_Description.chinese: 远古文明广泛耕种的一种紫色谷物。
Amaranth_Description.english: A kind of purple grain widely farmed by an ancient civilization.

AmphibianFossil_Description.chinese: 比较短的后腿说明它们是某种原始的蟾蜍。
AmphibianFossil_Description.english: The fairly short hind legs show that they were some kind of primitive toad.

Anchor_Description.english: It may have belonged to ancient pirates.

Anchovy_Description.english: A kind of small silver fish from the sea.

AncientDoll_Description.chinese: 一个满身污垢的古代玩偶。它可以用做玩具，也可以用做装饰，还可以用做某种仪式的道具。
AncientDoll_Description.english: An ancient doll covered in grime. It could be used as a toy, as a decoration, or as a prop in some kind of ritual.

AncientDrum_Description.chinese: 这是一个用木头和动物皮做的鼓。它能发出低沉、经久不息的声音。
AncientDrum_Description.english: This is a drum made of wood and animal skin. It can make a deep, long-lasting sound.

AncientFruitPot.chinese: 她的根长得很深……她在那里不会高兴。
AncientFruitPot.english: Her roots grow very deep... she wouldn't be happy there.

AncientFruit_Description.chinese: 千万年来冬眠中的水果。
AncientFruit_Description.english: A fruit that has been dormant for tens of millions of years.

AncientSeed_Description.chinese: 某个古代植物的干老种子。它显然早就死了……
AncientSeed_Description.english: A dry old seed of some ancient plant. It obviously died long ago...

AncientSword_Description.chinese: 这是一把古剑的残骸。绝大部分刀刃都生锈了，但是剑柄很精致。
AncientSword_Description.english: These are the remains of an ancient sword. Most of the blade has rusted, but the hilt is very exquisite.

Angler_Description.chinese: 它用发光的拟饵来吸引猎物。
Angler_Description.english: It uses a glowing lure to attract prey.

AppleSapling_Description.english: Matures into an adult apple tree in 28 days. Bears fruit in autumn. Only grows if the 8 "plots" nearby are all empty.

Apple_Description.chinese: 爽口的水果，可做果汁和醋。
Apple_Description.english: A crisp fruit, can be made into juice and vinegar.

ApricotSapling_Description.chinese: 28 天成熟为成年杏子树。春天结果。只有在附近 8 块“地块”都空置的情况下才会成长。
ApricotSapling_Description.english: Matures into an adult apricot tree in 28 days. Bears fruit in spring. Only grows if the 8 "plots" nearby are all empty.

Apricot_Description.chinese: 一种柔嫩的水果，但是果核硬如石头。
Apricot_Description.english: A tender fruit, but its pit is hard as stone.

AquamarineRing_Description.chinese: 增加 10% 的致命一击机会。

Aquamarine_Description.chinese: 一种闪闪发亮的蓝绿色宝石。
Aquamarine_Description.english: A kind of glittering blue-green gem.

ArcticShard_Description.chinese: 这块碎片散发出超脱尘世的蓝色光芒。
ArcticShard_Description.english: This shard gives off an otherworldly blue light.

Arrowhead_Description.chinese: 用于打猎的粗制尖状物。
Arrowhead_Description.english: A crudely made point used for hunting.

ArtichokeSeeds_Description.english: Sow in autumn. Matures in 8 days.

Artichoke_Description.chinese: 一种蓟科植物的芽。带有尖刺的外围叶子下，隐藏着一颗多肉而结实的内芯。

ArtifactSpot_Description.english: Uh... how did you get this? The ape bumped and hurt itself.

ArtifactTrove_Description.chinese: 铁匠可以帮你打开。这些宝藏一般会藏有古董和奇珍异宝。
ArtifactTrove_Description.english: A blacksmith can open it for you. These treasures usually hide antiques and rare curiosities.

Bait_Description.chinese: 能让鱼更快上钩。要先挂在鱼杆上。
Bait_Description.english: Makes fish bite faster. Must first be hung on a fishing rod.

BananaPudding_Description.chinese: 奶油甜点，具有美妙的热带风味。
BananaPudding_Description.english: A creamy dessert with a wonderful tropical flavor.

BananaSapling_Description.chinese: 28 天成熟为香蕉树。夏季结果实；种在姜岛上，一年四季都会结果实。
BananaSapling_Description.english: Matures into a banana tree in 28 days. Bears fruit in summer; planted on Ginger Island, it bears fruit all year round.

Banana_Description.english: A sweet tropical fruit, rich in starch.

BarbedHook_Description.chinese: 上钩的鱼更不容易跑掉，使“钓鱼条”靠紧猎物。对速度慢、弱小的鱼最有效。
BarbedHook_Description.english: Hooked fish are less likely to get away; keeps the "fishing bar" close to the prey. Most effective on slow, weak fish.

Baryte_Description.chinese: 最好的重晶石看起来就像沙漠玫瑰。
Baryte_Description.english: The best baryte looks like a desert rose.

Basalt_Description.chinese: 在灼热的岩浆附近形成。

BasicFertilizer_Description.english: Slightly improves soil quality, increasing your chance of growing high-quality crops. Mix into plowed soil when used.

BasicRetainingSoil_Description.chinese: 这种土壤有一定几率隔夜依然保持湿润。使用时加到犁过的土地中。
BasicRetainingSoil_Description.english: This soil has a certain chance of staying moist overnight. Mix into plowed soil when used.

Beet_Description.chinese: 香甜的根茎植物。它的叶子非常适合做沙拉。
Beet_Description.english: A sweet root vegetable. Its leaves are great for salad.

BerryBasket_Description.english: The wicker strips are covered in berry juice.

Bixite_Description.english: A black metallic ore. Has a square structure.

Blobfish_Description.english: These odd creatures float above the sea floor, eating any edible material in their path.

BlueDiscus_Description.chinese: 色彩鲜艳的热带鱼，在水族馆很受欢迎。
BlueDiscus_Description.english: A brightly colored tropical fish, very popular in aquariums.

BlueGrassStarter_Description.chinese: 播撒在农场上即可种出蓝色草丛。
BlueGrassStarter_Description.english: Scatter it on the farm to grow a patch of blue grass.

BlueJazz_Description.english: This flower is ball-shaped, so as to attract more butterflies.

BlueSlimeEgg_Description.chinese: 可以在史莱姆孵化器中孵化。
BlueSlimeEgg_Description.english: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.

BoneFlute_Description.english: A prehistoric wind instrument carved from animal bone. The sound it makes is eerie.

Book_Artifact_Description.english: Get a higher price when selling artifacts.

Bream_Description.chinese: 一种夜间活跃的常见河鱼。
Bream_Description.english: A common river fish, active at night.

BrickFloor_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

BroccoliSeeds_Description.chinese: 秋天播种，8 天成熟，收获之后还能继续生长。
BroccoliSeeds_Description.english: Sow in autumn, matures in 8 days, and keeps growing after harvest.

BurglarsRing_Description.chinese: 怪物有很大机会掉落战利品。

ButterflyPowder_Description.chinese: 撒在宠物身上即可将它驱逐出农场，驱逐后无法复原。
ButterflyPowder_Description.english: Sprinkle on a pet to banish it from the farm; banishing can't be undone.

CactusFruit_Description.chinese: 尖刺仙人掌的甜美果实。

CactusSeedsOutside.english: Must be planted indoors or on Ginger Island.

Carrot_Description.english: A fast-growing, brightly colored tuber that can be eaten as a snack.

CaskNoCellar.english: Only for use in the cellar.

CatalogueDescription.english: Lets you buy all kinds of wallpaper and flooring without leaving home!

Catfish_Description.chinese: 一种能在小溪里找到的罕见鱼类。
Catfish_Description.english: A rare fish that can be found in streams.

Cauliflower_Description.english: Valuable, but grows slowly. Although its color is pale, it's still rich in nutrients.

CaveCarrot_Description.chinese: 一种生长在山洞中的淀粉植物。能让矿工们更长时间工作。
CaveCarrot_Description.english: A starchy plant that grows in caves. Lets miners work longer.

CaveJelly_Description.chinese: 存在于地下湖泊里的罕见凝胶。
CaveJelly_Description.english: A rare jelly found in underground lakes.

Chanterelle_Description.chinese: 一种美味的蘑菇，味道像水果，稍辣。
Chanterelle_Description.english: A tasty mushroom; tastes like fruit, slightly spicy.

CherryBomb_Description.english: Makes a small explosion. Stand back!

CherrySapling_Description.chinese: 28 天成熟为成年樱桃树。春天结果。只有在附近 8 块“地块”都空置的情况下才会成长。

ChickenStatue_Description.english: A chicken statue on a bronze base. The ancient people of this area must have really liked chickens.

ChippedAmphora_Description.chinese: 陶瓷做的古老容器。用来运送各种货物。
ChippedAmphora_Description.english: An ancient container made of ceramic. Used to transport all kinds of goods.

ChocolateCake_Description.chinese: 香甜柔软，还有厚厚的软糖糖衣。
ChocolateCake_Description.english: Sweet and soft, with a thick fudge icing.

Chowder_Description.chinese: 在寒冷的海边过夜后，用它来暖身再好不过了。
Chowder_Description.english: After a night by the cold sea, nothing's better for warming up.

Coal_Description.english: A combustible ore, usable for crafting and smelting.

CobblestonePath_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
CobblestonePath_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

Coconut_Description.english: The seed of the coconut palm. Has many uses.

CoffeeBean_Description.chinese: 在春季和夏季种植。在小桶里放五颗咖啡豆可以制作咖啡。
CoffeeBean_Description.english: Plant in spring and summer. Put five coffee beans in a keg to make coffee.

Coffee_Description.chinese: 闻上去就很好喝。它肯定能让你充满活力。
Coffee_Description.english: It smells delicious. It will surely fill you with energy.

Coleslaw_Description.chinese: 口味清淡、新鲜，还很有益健康。
Coleslaw_Description.english: Light, fresh and very good for your health.

CommonMushroom_Description.english: Slightly firm, with a smooth texture.

CompleteBreakfast_Description.chinese: 你会准备好征服世界的！
CompleteBreakfast_Description.english: You'll be ready to conquer the world!

CopperOre_Description.english: A common ore that can be smelted into copper bars.

CornSeeds_Description.chinese: 夏天或秋天播种。14 天成熟，收获之后还能继续结果。
CornSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer or autumn. Matures in 14 days, and keeps bearing fruit after harvest.

Corn_Description.chinese: 最常见的庄稼之一。甜甜的新鲜玉米棒是夏天最好的小吃。
Corn_Description.english: One of the most common crops. Sweet fresh corn cobs are summer's best snack.

CrabCakes_Description.chinese: 蟹肉、面包屑和鸡蛋做成饼状，然后油炸至金棕色。
CrabCakes_Description.english: Crab meat, breadcrumbs and egg made into patties, then fried until golden brown.

CrabPot_Description.chinese: 放在水中，装上诱饵，隔一天再检查有没有抓到东西。可以在溪流、湖泊和大海使用。
CrabPot_Description.english: Put it in water, add bait, and check a day later whether it caught something. Can be used in streams, lakes and the sea.

Crab_Description.chinese: 长着两个强壮螯的海生甲壳纲生物。
Crab_Description.english: A marine crustacean with two strong pincers.

CrabshellRing_Description.chinese: 戒指的顶部是由附魔的蟹壳制成的。
CrabshellRing_Description.english: The top of the ring is made of enchanted crab shell.

Cranberries_Description.chinese: 这些红色的酸梅是传统的冬天食品。
Cranberries_Description.english: These red sour berries are a traditional winter food.

CranberryCandy_Description.chinese: 其中的甜味足以掩盖水果的苦味。
CranberryCandy_Description.english: Its sweetness is enough to cover the fruit's bitterness.

CranberrySeeds_Description.chinese: 秋天播种。7 天成熟，收获之后还能继续结果。
CranberrySeeds_Description.english: Sow in autumn. Matures in 7 days, and keeps bearing fruit after harvest.

Crayfish_Description.english: A small freshwater relative of the lobster.

Crimsonfish_Description.chinese: 它住在深海里但是喜欢在温暖的夏天产卵。
Crimsonfish_Description.english: It lives in the deep sea but likes to spawn in the warm summer.

CrispyBass_Description.chinese: 哇哦，裹上面包屑简直完美。
CrispyBass_Description.english: Wow, coated in breadcrumbs it's simply perfect.

Crocus_Description.english: A flower that blooms in winter.

CrystalFloor_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
CrystalFloor_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

CrystalFruit_Description.chinese: 一种在冬天出现的美味水果。
CrystalFruit_Description.english: A delicious fruit that appears in winter.

CrystalPath_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
CrystalPath_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

CuriosityLure_Description.chinese: 提高你钓到珍稀鱼的几率。
CuriosityLure_Description.english: Raises your chance of catching rare fish.

Daffodil_Description.chinese: 一种传统的春天花朵，适合送礼。
Daffodil_Description.english: A traditional spring flower, good as a gift.

Dandelion_Description.chinese: 虽然不算漂亮，但是叶子适合做沙拉。
Dandelion_Description.english: Though not exactly pretty, its leaves are good for salad.

DarkTalismanDescription.chinese: 你找到了{0}！它沾满了虫泥……
DarkTalismanDescription.english: You found {0}! It's covered in bug slime...

DecorativePot_Description.english: A replica of an ancient pot.

DeluxeBait_Description.chinese: 使鱼更快咬钩，并且让“钓鱼条”更长。
DeluxeBait_Description.english: Makes fish bite faster, and makes the "fishing bar" longer.

DeluxeFertilizer_Description.chinese: 大幅提高土壤品质，增加你种出高品质作物的可能性。使用时加到犁过的土地中。
DeluxeFertilizer_Description.english: Greatly improves soil quality, increasing your chance of growing high-quality crops. Mix into plowed soil when used.

DeluxeRetainingSoil_Description.chinese: 这种土壤能够隔夜依然百分百保持湿润。使用时加到犁过的土地中。
DeluxeRetainingSoil_Description.english: This soil stays one hundred percent moist overnight. Mix into plowed soil when used.

DeluxeSpeedGro_Description.chinese: 促进叶子生长。保证能让植物的生长速度加快 25%。使用时加到犁过的土地中。
DeluxeSpeedGro_Description.english: Stimulates leaf growth. Guaranteed to make plants grow 25% faster. Mix into plowed soil when used.

segments.pinyin: bǎi fēn zhī èr shí wǔ

Diamond_Description.chinese: 一种稀有且贵重的宝石。

DinosaurEgg_Description.chinese: 一个巨大的恐龙蛋……它的壳还保存的很完整呢！
DinosaurEgg_Description.english: A huge dinosaur egg... its shell is still very intact!

DinosaurMayonnaise_Description.chinese: 粘稠且呈乳脂状，带有鲜艳的绿色。闻起来有草和皮革的味道。
DinosaurMayonnaise_Description.english: Thick and creamy, with a bright green color. Smells of grass and leather.

DishOTheSea_Description.chinese: 让你在海上的寒风中保持温暖。
DishOTheSea_Description.english: Keeps you warm in the cold sea wind.

Dolomite_Description.chinese: 有时会在珊瑚礁上出现，大部分时候是在水下火山附近。
Dolomite_Description.english: Sometimes appears on coral reefs, but mostly near underwater volcanoes.

Dorado_Description.chinese: 凶猛的肉食鱼，有着绚烂的橙色鳞片。
Dorado_Description.english: A fierce carnivorous fish, with brilliant orange scales.

DragonTooth_Description.chinese: 传言说这是古代巨蛇的牙。它的牙釉质是由纯铱构成的！
DragonTooth_Description.english: Rumor says these are the teeth of ancient giant serpents. Its enamel is made of pure iridium!

DressedSpinner_Description.chinese: 金属片和彩色飘带构成的景象会吸引来鱼。增加钓鱼时的上钩率。
DressedSpinner_Description.english: The spectacle of metal plate and colored streamers attracts fish. Increases the bite rate when fishing.

DriedStarfish_Description.chinese: 原始海洋里的海星。这是个非常纯净的标本！
DriedStarfish_Description.english: A starfish from the primordial ocean. This is a very pure specimen!

Driftwood_Description.chinese: 从海里漂来的一块木头。
Driftwood_Description.english: A piece of wood that drifted in from the sea.

DrumBlock_Description.chinese: 走上去的时候会发出鼓声。
DrumBlock_Description.english: Makes a drum sound when you walk onto it.

DuckMayonnaise_Description.chinese: 香味浓郁的黄色蛋黄酱。

DwarfGadget_Description.chinese: 这个小工具是矮人先进工艺的一小块结晶。它还在发光和响动，但是你无法理解它的工作原理。
DwarfGadget_Description.english: This gadget is a small crystallization of the dwarves' advanced craft. It's still glowing and making noise, but you can't understand how it works.

DwarfScrollIII_Description.chinese: 一个写满矮人语的黄色羊皮卷轴。这一个上面系着蓝色绳子。
DwarfScrollIII_Description.english: A yellow parchment scroll full of dwarvish. This one is tied with a blue cord.

DwarfScrollII_Description.chinese: 一个写满矮人语的黄色羊皮卷轴。这一个上面系着绿色丝带。
DwarfScrollII_Description.english: A yellow parchment scroll full of dwarvish. This one is tied with a green ribbon.

DwarfScrollIV_Description.chinese: 一个写满矮人语的黄色羊皮卷轴。这一个上面系着金色链子。
DwarfScrollIV_Description.english: A yellow parchment scroll full of dwarvish. This one is tied with a gold chain.

DwarfScrollI_Description.chinese: 一个写满矮人语的黄色羊皮卷轴。这一个上面系着红色蝴蝶结。
DwarfScrollI_Description.english: A yellow parchment scroll full of dwarvish. This one is tied with a red bow.

DwarvishHelm_Description.chinese: 这是矮人常戴的头盔之一。厚厚的金属镀层能保护他们不受落石伤害。
DwarvishHelm_Description.english: This is one of the helmets dwarves often wear. The thick metal plating protects them from falling rocks.

EarthCrystal_Description.chinese: 在地表附近发现的树脂状物质。
EarthCrystal_Description.english: A resin-like substance found near the ground's surface.

Ectoplasm_Description.chinese: 厚实的粘液，法师不知道为何想要它。
Ectoplasm_Description.english: Thick slime; no one knows why the wizard wants it.

EggplantParmesan_Description.chinese: 味道浓烈，芝香浓郁，好吃极了。
EggplantParmesan_Description.english: Strong flavor, rich cheesy aroma, extremely tasty.

EggplantSeeds_Description.chinese: 秋天播种。5 天成熟，收获之后还能继续结果。
EggplantSeeds_Description.english: Sow in autumn. Matures in 5 days, and keeps bearing fruit after harvest.

Eggplant_Description.chinese: 味道浓郁，营养丰富，是西红柿的近亲。炒着吃或者炖着吃味道都很不错。
Eggplant_Description.english: Rich in flavor and nutrition, a close relative of the tomato. Tastes great stir-fried or stewed.

ElvishJewelry_Description.chinese: 很脏但是依然美丽。上边有被认为是古代精灵语的流畅字迹。但还没有人见过精灵的遗骸。
ElvishJewelry_Description.english: Dirty but still beautiful. On it is flowing script thought to be the ancient elvish language. But nobody has ever seen an elf's remains.

Emerald_Description.chinese: 一种亮绿色的珍贵宝石。
Emerald_Description.english: A precious gem of bright green.

Enricher_Description.chinese: 安装在洒水器上并装入肥料，在其附近播撒种子时便会自动施肥。
Enricher_Description.english: Fit it on a sprinkler and load it with fertilizer; when you sow seeds nearby it fertilizes them automatically.

Escargot_Description.chinese: 淋上黄油的田螺，做的恰到火候。
Escargot_Description.english: River snails drizzled with butter, cooked just right.

Esperite_Description.chinese: 受到激发后，这种晶石会发出明亮的绿色荧光。
Esperite_Description.english: When stimulated, this crystal gives off bright green fluorescence.

ExplosiveAmmo_Description.english: Can be fired with a slingshot.

FairyDust_Description.chinese: 洒在小桶、熔炉和其他精炼设备上，可以立刻获得正在生产的产品。
FairyDust_Description.english: Sprinkle on kegs, furnaces and other refining equipment to instantly get the product being made.

FairyRose_Description.chinese: 传言这种花朵的香味会吸引小仙女而来。
FairyRose_Description.english: Legend has it this flower's scent attracts little fairies.

FairySeeds_Description.chinese: 秋天下种。12 天产出神秘的花朵。多种颜色。
FairySeeds_Description.english: Sow in autumn. Produces a mysterious flower in 12 days. Many colors.

FairyStone_Description.chinese: 古老的矿工歌谣里说，这些石头是古代精灵的骨头做的。
FairyStone_Description.english: An old miners' ballad says these stones are made of the bones of ancient elves.

FarAwayStone_Description.chinese: 来历不明的晶石，似乎能装到什么东西上面。
FarAwayStone_Description.english: A crystal of unknown origin; it looks like it could fit onto something.

FarmersLunch_Description.english: Makes sure you can keep working.

FiberSeeds_Description.chinese: 所有季节都可以种植。不需要浇水。用镰刀收割。7 天长成。
FiberSeeds_Description.english: Can be sown in any season. Doesn't need watering. Harvest with a scythe. Grows in 7 days.

FiddleheadFern_Description.chinese: 这些嫩芽是一种可食用的特产。
FiddleheadFern_Description.english: These tender shoots are an edible specialty.

FiddleheadRisotto_Description.chinese: 香软的米饭拌上清炒的蕨菜芽。汤有点淡。
FiddleheadRisotto_Description.english: Soft rice mixed with lightly fried fern shoots. The broth is a little bland.

FieldSnack_Description.chinese: 给饥饿的采集者迅速补充能量。
FieldSnack_Description.english: Quickly restores energy for a hungry forager.

FireOpal_Description.chinese: 一种非常罕见的猫眼石，它得名于它上面的红色斑点。
FireOpal_Description.english: A very rare opal, named for the red spots on it.

FireQuartz_Description.chinese: 一种常见于熔岩附近的火红色晶体。
FireQuartz_Description.english: A fiery red crystal commonly found near lava.

FireworksGreen_Description.chinese: 一种庆祝节日和活动的传统习俗。小心燃放！
FireworksGreen_Description.english: A traditional custom for celebrating festivals and events. Set off with care!

FireworksPurple_Description.chinese: 一种庆祝节日和活动的传统习俗。小心燃放！
FireworksPurple_Description.english: A traditional custom for celebrating festivals and events. Set off with care!

FireworksRed_Description.chinese: 一种庆祝节日和活动的传统习俗。小心燃放！
FireworksRed_Description.english: A traditional custom for celebrating festivals and events. Set off with care!

FishStew_Description.chinese: 大海的味道扑面而来。不过尝起来更好。
FishStew_Description.english: The smell of the sea hits you in the face. But it tastes even better.

Flounder_Description.chinese: 它生活在底部，所以两只眼睛都在它的头顶上。
Flounder_Description.english: It lives on the bottom, so both its eyes are on top of its head.

Fluorapatite_Description.chinese: 人类牙齿中含有少量的这种物质。
Fluorapatite_Description.english: Human teeth contain small amounts of this substance.

FluteBlock_Description.chinese: 走上去的时候会发出笛子的声音。
FluteBlock_Description.english: Makes a flute sound when you walk onto it.

FossilizedRibs_Description.chinese: 很久以前，这些肋骨保护着一个大型动物的身体。
FossilizedRibs_Description.english: Long ago, these ribs protected the body of a large animal.

FossilizedSpine_Description.chinese: 一列紧密连接的脊椎骨。
FossilizedSpine_Description.english: A row of tightly connected vertebrae.

FossilizedTail_Description.chinese: 这条尾巴的尖端像棍子。
FossilizedTail_Description.english: The tip of this tail is like a club.

FriedEgg_Description.english: The front looks like the sun.

FrozenGeode_Description.chinese: 你可以找铁匠破开这块晶球。
FrozenGeode_Description.english: You can get a blacksmith to break open this geode.

FrozenTear_Description.chinese: 传说是由雪怪眼泪结成的晶体。
FrozenTear_Description.english: Said in legend to be a crystal formed from a yeti's tears.

FurnitureCatalogueDescription.chinese: 让你不出门就能买到各种各样的家具！
FurnitureCatalogueDescription.english: Lets you buy all kinds of furniture without leaving home!

GalaxySoul_Description.chinese: 将 3 份银河之魂锻造进银河武器即可解锁最终形态。
GalaxySoul_Description.english: Forge 3 galaxy souls into a galaxy weapon to unlock its final form.

GarlicSeeds_Description.english: Sow in spring. Matures in 4 days.

Garlic_Description.chinese: 给菜肴增加一些风味。质量好的大蒜可能会特别辣。
Garlic_Description.english: Adds some flavor to dishes. Good-quality garlic can be especially spicy.

Gate_Description.english: Gives you a way to pass through fences.

Geminite_Description.chinese: 出现时总是大量聚集在一起。
Geminite_Description.english: Always appears gathered in large clusters.

Geode_Description.chinese: 你可以找铁匠破开这块晶球。
Geode_Description.english: You can get a blacksmith to break open this geode.

GhostCrystal_Description.chinese: 这块水晶的附近有着冰冷的光环。
GhostCrystal_Description.english: This crystal has an icy aura around it.

Ghostfish_Description.chinese: 一种在地下湖里能找到的苍白色的盲鱼。
Ghostfish_Description.english: A pale blind fish that can be found in underground lakes.

GingerAle_Description.chinese: 一种好喝的苏打水，因为对胃有舒缓作用而为人们所知晓。
GingerAle_Description.english: A tasty soda water, known for its soothing effect on the stomach.

Ginger_Description.chinese: 这种根茎味道辛辣，据说可以提高活力。
Ginger_Description.english: This root tastes pungent; said to boost vitality.

GlacierfishJr_Description.english: The glacier fish has had offspring...

Glacierfish_Description.english: Builds nests at the bottom of glaciers.

GlassShards_Description.chinese: 被几个世纪海浪冲刷光滑的玻璃碎片混合物。可能是古代拼花装饰或者项链上的东西。
GlassShards_Description.english: A mix of glass shards, smoothed by centuries of ocean waves. Possibly from an ancient mosaic or a necklace.

GlazedYams_Description.chinese: 又香又甜……加糖让它有了一点焦糖味。
GlazedYams_Description.english: Fragrant and sweet... the added sugar gives it a slight caramel taste.

GlowstoneRing_Description.chinese: 散发出稳定的光芒，并增加收集物品的范围。
GlowstoneRing_Description.english: Gives off steady light, and increases the range for collecting items.

GoatCheese_Description.chinese: 用羊奶制成的柔软奶酪。
GoatCheese_Description.english: Soft cheese made from goat's milk.

Goby_Description.chinese: 有些虾虎鱼能攀上瀑布。

GoldOre_Description.chinese: 一种珍贵的矿石，能被熔炼成金锭。
GoldOre_Description.english: A precious ore that can be smelted into gold bars.

GoldenAnimalCracker_Description.chinese: 给一只农场动物吃即可使其产量永久翻倍，对猪无效。
GoldenAnimalCracker_Description.english: Feed it to a farm animal to permanently double its output; doesn't work on pigs.

GoldenCoconut_Description.chinese: 这玩意儿很难开，但是有专家可以敲开。
GoldenCoconut_Description.english: This thing is very hard to open, but an expert can crack it.

GoldenEgg_Description.chinese: 非常独特、罕见的蛋，金色的蛋壳非常坚固。
GoldenEgg_Description.english: A very unique, rare egg; the golden shell is very sturdy.

GoldenMask_Description.chinese: 一个大概被用于古代法术仪式的恐怖黄金面具。前额部位嵌着一个巨大的紫色宝石。
GoldenMask_Description.english: A frightening gold mask probably used in ancient magic rituals. A huge purple gem is set in the forehead.

GoldenPumpkin_Description.chinese: 十分贵重，但没有任何实际作用。
GoldenPumpkin_Description.english: Very valuable, but has no practical use.

GoldenRelic_Description.chinese: 是一个黄金板，它的正面刻绘着象形文字和图画。
GoldenRelic_Description.english: A gold tablet, with hieroglyphs and pictures carved on its front.

GoldenWalnut_Description.chinese: 对姜岛的鹦鹉来说，这种坚果是最好的美味。
GoldenWalnut_Description.english: To Ginger Island's parrots, this nut is the finest delicacy.

GourmetTomatoSalt_Description.chinese: 一种稀有、美味、可口的盐。

Granite_Description.chinese: 有着斑点的矿石，经常用于建筑。
Granite_Description.english: A speckled ore, often used in construction.

GrapeStarter_Description.chinese: 秋天播种。10 天成熟，之后循环生产。在架子上生长。
GrapeStarter_Description.english: Sow in autumn. Matures in 10 days, then keeps producing. Grows on a trellis.

GrassBook_Description.chinese: 在草丛和庄稼中的移动速度大幅增加。
GrassBook_Description.english: Movement speed through grass and crops is greatly increased.

GrassStarter_Description.chinese: 把它种在你的农场上，来得到一块新的草坪。
GrassStarter_Description.english: Plant it on your farm to get a new patch of lawn.

GravelPath_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
GravelPath_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

GreenBean_Description.chinese: 爽脆口感的多汁小豆子。
GreenBean_Description.english: A juicy little bean with a crisp bite.

GreenRainWeeds_Description.chinese: 可能含有纤维或混合种子。
GreenRainWeeds_Description.english: May contain fiber or mixed seeds.

GreenSlimeEgg_Description.chinese: 可以在史莱姆孵化器中孵化。
GreenSlimeEgg_Description.english: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.

GreenTea_Description.chinese: 由轻加工的茶叶制成的令人愉快的提神饮料。
GreenTea_Description.english: A pleasant, refreshing drink made from lightly processed tea leaves.

Halibut_Description.chinese: 形状扁平、居住在大洋底的鱼。
Halibut_Description.english: A flat-shaped fish that lives on the ocean floor.

HardwoodFence_Description.english: The most durable kind of fence.

Hardwood_Description.chinese: 一种特殊的木材，有更高的强度和观赏性。
Hardwood_Description.english: A special wood with greater strength and beauty.

Hay_Description.chinese: 晾干的草料，可以用来喂动物。
Hay_Description.english: Dried grass fodder, can be used to feed animals.

Hedge_Description.chinese: 造型灌木，可当作围栏使用。
Hedge_Description.english: A shaped shrub that can be used as a fence.

Helvite_Description.chinese: 出现的时候总按三角形排列。
Helvite_Description.english: Always arranged in triangles when it appears.

Hematite_Description.chinese: 一种主要成分为铁的矿石，带有一些特别的磁性。
Hematite_Description.english: An ore whose main component is iron, with some special magnetism.

Holly_Description.chinese: 它的叶子和鲜红的浆果让它成为了极受欢迎的冬天饰品。
Holly_Description.english: Its leaves and bright red berries make it a very popular winter decoration.

HopsStarter_Description.chinese: 夏天播种。11 天成熟，之后循环生产。在架子上生长。
HopsStarter_Description.english: Sow in summer. Matures in 11 days, then keeps producing. Grows on a trellis.

Hops_Description.chinese: 带苦味刺鼻的花朵，用于酿酒。
Hops_Description.english: Bitter, pungent flowers, used in brewing.

HorseFlute_Description.chinese: 吹这支笛子可以召唤出你的马，只在户外有效。
HorseFlute_Description.english: Blowing this flute summons your horse; only works outdoors.

HotJavaRing_Description.chinese: 大幅增加狩猎怪物时找到咖啡饮料的概率。
HotJavaRing_Description.english: Greatly increases the chance of finding coffee drinks when hunting monsters.

HyperSpeedGro_Description.chinese: 促进叶子生长。保证能让植物的生长速度加快 33% 以上。使用时加到犁过的土地中。
HyperSpeedGro_Description.english: Stimulates leaf growth. Guaranteed to make plants grow over 33% faster. Mix into plowed soil when used.

segments.pinyin: bǎi fēn zhī sān shí sān

IceCream_Description.chinese: 很难找到一个不喜欢它的人。
IceCream_Description.english: It's hard to find someone who doesn't like it.

IcePip_Description.chinese: 一种在极寒条件下生长的稀有鱼类。
IcePip_Description.english: A rare fish that grows in extremely cold conditions.

ImmunityBand_Description.chinese: 戒指的顶部是由附魔的紫色毛绒制成的。
ImmunityBand_Description.english: The top of the ring is made of enchanted purple wool.

IridiumBand_Description.chinese: 光辉，吸引物品，增加 10% 的攻击伤害。
IridiumBand_Description.english: Glows, attracts items, increases attack damage by 10%.

IridiumOre_Description.chinese: 一种有着很多稀奇属性的独特矿石。能被熔炼成铱锭。
IridiumOre_Description.english: A unique ore with many curious properties. Can be smelted into iridium bars.

IridiumSprinkler_Description.chinese: 每天早晨灌溉临近的 24 个地块。
IridiumSprinkler_Description.english: Waters the 24 adjacent plots every morning.

IronFence_Description.english: More durable than a stone fence.

IronOre_Description.chinese: 一种常见的矿石，能被熔炼成铁锭。
IronOre_Description.english: A common ore that can be smelted into iron bars.

JadeRing_Description.chinese: 增加 10% 的致命一击能量。

Jagoite_Description.chinese: 含有大量的小水晶，让它闪闪发光。
Jagoite_Description.english: Contains lots of tiny crystals, which make it glitter.

Jamborite_Description.chinese: 这些晶石是如此紧密地排列在一起，以至于它们看起来都有些模糊了。
Jamborite_Description.english: These crystals are packed so tightly together that they even look a bit blurry.

Jasper_Description.chinese: 仔细打磨之后，这块石头能发出迷人的光彩。几千年以来都被人们作为奖品。
Jasper_Description.english: Carefully polished, this stone gives off a charming luster. People have prized it for thousands of years.

JazzSeeds_Description.chinese: 春天下种。7 天产出蓝色绒球花朵。
JazzSeeds_Description.english: Sow in spring. Produces a blue pompom flower in 7 days.

JournalScrap_Description.chinese: 从一本旧日记上撕下的残页，破旧潮湿……
JournalScrap_Description.english: A leftover page torn from an old diary, worn and damp...

Juice_Description.chinese: 一种甜润，富含营养的饮料。

JukeboxRing_Description.chinese: 随机播放你已听过的音乐类型。
JukeboxRing_Description.english: Randomly plays kinds of music you've heard.

KaleSeeds_Description.chinese: 春天播种。6 天成熟。用镰刀收获。
KaleSeeds_Description.english: Sow in spring. Matures in 6 days. Harvest with a scythe.

Kale_Description.chinese: 拿这些柔软的叶子蔬菜什锦盖饭或者做汤，味道好极了！
Kale_Description.english: Use these soft leafy greens on mixed rice bowls or in soup; it tastes great!

Kyanite_Description.chinese: 几何面如同玻璃般光滑。
Kyanite_Description.english: Its geometric faces are as smooth as glass.

LGoatMilk_Description.chinese: 一加仑口感细腻的山羊奶。
LGoatMilk_Description.english: A gallon of fine-textured goat milk.

LargeBrownEgg_Description.chinese: 这是个非常大的棕色鸡蛋！
LargeBrownEgg_Description.english: This is a very big brown egg!

LargeWhiteEgg_Description.chinese: 这是个非常大的白色鸡蛋！
LargeWhiteEgg_Description.english: This is a very big white egg!

LargemouthBass_Description.chinese: 一种住在湖里的受欢迎鱼类。
LargemouthBass_Description.english: A popular fish that lives in lakes.

LavaEel_Description.chinese: 它可以在炽热的岩浆中生存。
LavaEel_Description.english: It can survive in scorching lava.

LeadBobber_Description.chinese: 为你的“钓鱼条”添加了重量，阻止它在触底的时候反弹。
LeadBobber_Description.english: Adds weight to your "fishing bar", stopping it bouncing when it hits the bottom.

Leek_Description.english: A tasty close relative of the onion.

LegendII_Description.english: The successor of the Legend fish.

Legend_Description.chinese: 万鱼之王！传说它永远不会被抓到。
Legend_Description.english: King of all fish! Legend says it can never be caught.

LemonStone_Description.chinese: 有些人说这种粉状的晶石是矮人的佳肴。
LemonStone_Description.english: Some say this powdery crystal is a dwarf delicacy.

Limestone_Description.chinese: 非常常见的一种石头。价值不高。
Limestone_Description.english: A very common kind of stone. Not worth much.

Lingcod_Description.chinese: 可怕的捕食者，会吞下一切可以吃下的东西。
Lingcod_Description.english: A frightening predator that swallows anything it can eat.

Lionfish_Description.chinese: 好斗的食肉性鱼，有毒刺。
Lionfish_Description.english: An aggressive carnivorous fish with venomous spines.

LobsterBisque_Description.chinese: 这碗精致的汤用了威利家秘传的配方。
LobsterBisque_Description.english: This delicate soup uses Willy's family secret recipe.

Lobster_Description.chinese: 居住在海中、尾部强壮的大型甲壳纲动物。
Lobster_Description.english: A large crustacean living in the sea, with a strong tail.

LostAxe_Description.english: Robin is looking for it everywhere.

LuckyRing_Description.chinese: 象征月亮的标志，据说可以给佩戴它的人带来好运。
LuckyRing_Description.english: An emblem symbolizing the moon, said to bring good luck to whoever wears it.

Lumber_Description.chinese: 建房子以及当燃料的常用资源。
Lumber_Description.english: A common resource for building houses and as fuel.

Lunarite_Description.chinese: 这些坑坑洼洼的矿石会紧密的聚集在一起。
Lunarite_Description.english: These pitted ores gather tightly together.

MagicBait_Description.chinese: 能让你在所有类型的水中钓出所有季节、时间、天气的鱼。
MagicBait_Description.english: Lets you catch fish of every season, time and weather in all types of water.

MagicInkDescription.chinese: 你找到了法师丢失的{0}！最好把它还给法师。
MagicInkDescription.english: You found the wizard's lost {0}! Better return it to the wizard.

MagicRockCandy_Description.chinese: 稀有而强力的糖果，灌注了五彩碎片的精华。
MagicRockCandy_Description.english: A rare and powerful candy, infused with the essence of prismatic shards.

MagmaCap_Description.chinese: 一种非常罕见的蘑菇，生长在熔岩池旁。
MagmaCap_Description.english: A very rare mushroom, growing beside lava pools.

MagmaGeode_Description.chinese: 你可以找铁匠破开这块晶球。
MagmaGeode_Description.english: You can get a blacksmith to break open this geode.

MagnetRing_Description.chinese: 增加你收集物品的半径。

Magnet_Description.chinese: 增加钓鱼时发现宝藏的概率。但是，鱼儿可不喜欢它的味道。
Magnet_Description.english: Increases the chance of finding treasure when fishing. But the fish don't like its taste.

MagnifyingGlassDescription.chinese: 你收到了{0}！你现在有能力找到“秘密纸条”。这些纸条揭示了珍贵且实用的信息，可在你的收藏选项卡中查看。
MagnifyingGlassDescription.english: You received {0}! You now have the ability to find "secret notes". These notes reveal precious and useful information, and can be viewed in your collections tab.

MahoganySeed_Description.chinese: 可以种出一棵桃花心木。

MakiRoll_Description.english: Fish and rice wrapped in seaweed.

Malachite_Description.chinese: 一种非常受欢迎的装饰品，经常用在雕塑中，也被用来做绿色的颜料。
Malachite_Description.english: A very popular ornament, often used in sculpture, and also used to make green pigment.

MangoSapling_Description.chinese: 28 天成熟为芒果树。夏季结果实；种在姜岛上，一年四季都会结果实。
MangoSapling_Description.english: Matures into a mango tree in 28 days. Bears fruit in summer; planted on Ginger Island, it bears fruit all year round.

MangoStickyRice_Description.chinese: 甜芒果和椰子让糯米别具风味。
MangoStickyRice_Description.english: Sweet mango and coconut give the sticky rice a special flavor.

Mango_Description.chinese: 大而甜的热带水果，有独特的味道。
Mango_Description.english: A big, sweet tropical fruit with a unique flavor.

MapleBar_Description.english: A doughnut topped with maple syrup.

MapleSyrup_Description.english: A sweet syrup with a unique flavor.

Marble_Description.chinese: 一种非常受欢迎的雕塑和建筑原料。
Marble_Description.english: A very popular material for sculpture and construction.

Mayonnaise_Description.chinese: 看起来很适合抹在面包上。
Mayonnaise_Description.english: Looks very good for spreading on bread.

Mead_Description.chinese: 蜂蜜制成的发酵饮料。适度饮用。
Mead_Description.english: A fermented drink made from honey. Drink in moderation.

MegaBomb_Description.chinese: 会发生大爆炸。使用时请格外小心。
MegaBomb_Description.english: Makes a big explosion. Take extra care when using it.

MelonSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer. Matures in 12 days.

MermaidsPendant_Description.chinese: 把它送给你未来的伴侣。
MermaidsPendant_Description.english: Give it to your future partner.

MidnightCarp_Description.chinese: 这种害羞的鱼只在晚上感到舒适。
MidnightCarp_Description.english: This shy fish only feels comfortable at night.

MidnightSquid_Description.chinese: 海洋暮色深处陌生且神秘的居民。
MidnightSquid_Description.english: A strange, mysterious dweller of the ocean's twilight depths.

MixedFlowerSeeds_Description.chinese: 各类花的种子，种下去看看会长出什么！
MixedFlowerSeeds_Description.english: Seeds of all kinds of flowers; plant them and see what grows!

MixedSeeds_Description.chinese: 各种种子都有一点。种下它们，看看长出来什么东西！
MixedSeeds_Description.english: A bit of every kind of seed. Plant them and see what comes up!

MonsterMusk_Description.chinese: 喷上这个可以吸引更多的怪物出来。
MonsterMusk_Description.english: Spray this on to attract more monsters out.

Morel_Description.chinese: 因为独特的味道而深受欢迎。
Morel_Description.english: Very popular for its unique flavor.

MossSoup_Description.chinese: 浓稠而且黏糊糊，勉强能喝。
MossSoup_Description.english: Thick and slimy, just barely drinkable.

Moss_Description.chinese: 生长在阴暗处的特殊植物。
Moss_Description.english: A special plant that grows in shady places.

MovieTicket_Description.chinese: 允许一个人进入电影院。送给朋友就可以邀请他们和你一起看电影。
MovieTicket_Description.english: Admits one person to the cinema. Give it to a friend to invite them to watch a film with you.

MsAngler_Description.chinese: 它用发光的拟饵来吸引猎物。
MsAngler_Description.english: It uses a glowing lure to attract prey.

Mudstone_Description.chinese: 有细密的纹理，是上古的粘土或者泥巴变成的。
Mudstone_Description.english: Has a fine grain; formed from ancient clay or mud.

MummifiedBat_Description.chinese: 精致的翅膀被完美地保存了下来。
MummifiedBat_Description.english: The delicate wings have been perfectly preserved.

MummifiedFrog_Description.chinese: 这只古老的青蛙可能生活在丛林的树冠里。
MummifiedFrog_Description.english: This ancient frog may have lived in the jungle canopy.

MuscleRemedy_Description.chinese: 当你使自己的身体过度劳累时，喝下它来解除“筋疲力尽”的状态。
MuscleRemedy_Description.english: When you have overworked your body, drink it to remove the "exhausted" state.

MushroomTreeSeed_Description.chinese: 把它种在你的农场上，可以种出蘑菇树。
MushroomTreeSeed_Description.english: Plant it on your farm to grow a mushroom tree.

Mussel_Description.chinese: 结群生活的双壳类生物。
Mussel_Description.english: A bivalve creature that lives in groups.

MutantCarp_Description.chinese: 下水道中古怪的水让这条鲤鱼变得畸形了。
MutantCarp_Description.english: The strange water in the sewer has made this carp deformed.

MysteryBox_Description.chinese: 铁匠可以帮你打开。谁知道里面装着什么？
MysteryBox_Description.english: A blacksmith can open it for you. Who knows what's inside?

MysticSyrup_Description.chinese: 非常罕见的糖浆，据说具有魔法属性。
MysticSyrup_Description.english: A very rare syrup, said to have magic properties.

NapalmRing_Description.chinese: 当你击败敌人时，它们会爆炸。
NapalmRing_Description.english: When you defeat enemies, they explode.

NautilusFossil_Description.chinese: 这肯定是在亿万年前从一个古老的珊瑚礁上被冲上岸的。
NautilusFossil_Description.english: This must have been washed ashore from an ancient coral reef hundreds of millions of years ago.

Nekoite_Description.chinese: 这些精致的碎片能够拼成一片小小的粉色牧场。
Nekoite_Description.english: These delicate shards can form a tiny pink meadow.

Neptunite_Description.chinese: 一种黝黑的晶石，反光性一般都比较好。
Neptunite_Description.english: A jet-black crystal, generally quite reflective.

OakResin_Description.chinese: 从橡树树液中提取的粘稠、芬芳的物质。
OakResin_Description.english: A sticky, fragrant substance extracted from oak sap.

Obsidian_Description.chinese: 一种火山岩，当岩浆极速冷却时就会形成。
Obsidian_Description.english: A volcanic rock that forms when magma cools extremely fast.

OceanStone_Description.chinese: 古老的传说声称这些石头是远古美人鱼的镶嵌画。
OceanStone_Description.english: An old legend claims these stones are mosaics of ancient mermaids.

Oil_Description.chinese: 可煎可炸的万用食用油。
Oil_Description.english: All-purpose cooking oil for frying and deep-frying.

OilofGarlic_Description.chinese: 喝下它，弱小的魔物就会避开你。
OilofGarlic_Description.english: Drink it, and weak monsters will avoid you.

OmniGeode_Description.chinese: 铁匠能帮你把它敲开。这种晶球包含了多种多样的矿物。
OmniGeode_Description.english: A blacksmith can crack it open for you. This kind of geode contains many different minerals.

Opal_Description.chinese: 它的内部结构导致它能够反射出彩虹的光辉。
Opal_Description.english: Its internal structure lets it reflect the brilliance of a rainbow.

OrangeSapling_Description.chinese: 28 天成熟为成年橙子树。夏天结果。只有在附近 8 块“地块”都空置的情况下才会成长。
OrangeSapling_Description.english: Matures into an adult orange tree in 28 days. Bears fruit in summer. Only grows if the 8 "plots" nearby are all empty.

Orange_Description.chinese: 多汁芬香，满满的都是夏天的香味。
Orange_Description.english: Juicy and fragrant, full of the scent of summer.

OrnamentalFan_Description.chinese: 这把精致的扇子很有可能属于一个贵妇人。历史学家认为星露谷是第六纪元富人的度假胜地。
OrnamentalFan_Description.english: This exquisite fan very likely belonged to a noblewoman. Historians believe Stardew Valley was a resort for the rich in the sixth era.

OrnateNecklace_Description.chinese: 在浴室外的水中找到的华丽项链。还是湿的……
OrnateNecklace_Description.english: A gorgeous necklace found in the water outside the bathhouse. Still wet...

Orpiment_Description.chinese: 尽管它毒性很强，它还是有广泛的加工以及制药用途。
Orpiment_Description.english: Although it is very toxic, it still has wide uses in manufacturing and medicine.

OstrichEgg_Description.chinese: 这可能是世界上最大的鸟蛋了。
OstrichEgg_Description.english: This may be the biggest bird egg in the world.

Oyster_Description.chinese: 以滤水的方式觅食。在这个过程中，会清除环境中的有毒有害物质。
Oyster_Description.english: Feeds by filtering water. In the process, it removes toxic and harmful substances from the environment.

PaleBroth_Description.chinese: 带有一点黄色的精致清汤。
PaleBroth_Description.english: A delicate clear soup with a hint of yellow.

PalmFossil_Description.chinese: 棕榈化石比较常见，但这一个恰好是比较完整的。
PalmFossil_Description.english: Palm fossils are fairly common, but this one happens to be fairly complete.

ParsnipSeedPackage_SomeoneElse.english: This package belongs to someone else.

ParsnipSeeds_Description.english: Sow in spring. Matures in 4 days.

Parsnip_Description.chinese: 一种和胡萝卜很相似的春季块茎植物。它营养丰富且带有泥土的气息。
Parsnip_Description.english: A spring tuber very similar to the carrot. It's nutritious and has an earthy aroma.

PeachSapling_Description.chinese: 28 天成熟为成年桃子树。夏天结果。只有在附近 8 块“地块”都空置的情况下才会成长。
PeachSapling_Description.english: Matures into an adult peach tree in 28 days. Bears fruit in summer. Only grows if the 8 "plots" nearby are all empty.

PepperPoppers_Description.chinese: 裹着面包屑的辣青椒装满了乳酪。
PepperPoppers_Description.english: Breaded hot green peppers filled with cheese.

PepperSeeds_Description.chinese: 夏天播种。5 天成熟，收获之后还能继续结果。
PepperSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer. Matures in 5 days, and keeps bearing fruit after harvest.

Periwinkle_Description.chinese: 一种居住在蓝色贝壳里的小型淡水蜗牛。
Periwinkle_Description.english: A small freshwater snail that lives in a blue shell.

PetLicense_Description.chinese: 邀请一只新宠物到你家。如果室外的宠物碗数量不够，宠物会不高兴。
PetLicense_Description.english: Invite a new pet to your home. If there aren't enough pet bowls outdoors, the pets will be unhappy.

PetrifiedSlime_Description.chinese: 这小家伙也许有十万岁了。
PetrifiedSlime_Description.english: This little guy may be a hundred thousand years old.

PhoenixRing_Description.chinese: 在战斗中被击倒后恢复些许生命值，一天仅限一次。
PhoenixRing_Description.english: Recover some health after being knocked down in battle; only once a day.

Pickles_Description.english: A jar of homemade pickled vegetables.

Pike_Description.chinese: 一种很难捕捉的淡水鱼。
Pike_Description.english: A freshwater fish that's very hard to catch.

PineTar_Description.chinese: 从松树树液中提取的刺鼻的物质。
PineTar_Description.english: A pungent substance extracted from pine sap.

PineappleSeeds_Description.chinese: 在温暖的天气里种下去。14 天成熟，之后会持续生产果实。
PineappleSeeds_Description.english: Plant in warm weather. Matures in 14 days, then keeps producing fruit.

Pineapple_Description.english: A tropical delicacy, with a sweet smell that fills your nose.

PinkCake_Description.chinese: 蛋糕上面有小小的心型蜡烛。
PinkCake_Description.english: There are tiny heart-shaped candles on the cake.

PiratesLocket_Description.english: This is an old pirate's keepsake.

Poi_Description.chinese: 一种传统食物，趁还新鲜时食用有一种细腻、微甜的味道。
Poi_Description.english: A traditional food; eaten while still fresh, it has a delicate, slightly sweet taste.

PomegranateSapling_Description.chinese: 28 天成熟为成年石榴树。秋天结果。只有在附近 8 块“地块”都空置的情况下才会成长。
PomegranateSapling_Description.english: Matures into an adult pomegranate tree in 28 days. Bears fruit in autumn. Only grows if the 8 "plots" nearby are all empty.

Pomegranate_Description.chinese: 果子里是满满的多汁种子。
Pomegranate_Description.english: The fruit is full of juicy seeds.

PoppySeeds_Description.chinese: 夏天下种。7 天产出大红花。
PoppySeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer. Produces a big red flower in 7 days.

Poppy_Description.chinese: 虞美人花颜色鲜艳，有药用价值。
Poppy_Description.english: The poppy has bright colors and medicinal value.

PoppyseedMuffin_Description.english: Has a kind of calming effect.

PotatoSeeds_Description.chinese: 春天播种。6 天成熟，有一定几率一次收获多个土豆。
PotatoSeeds_Description.english: Sow in spring. Matures in 6 days; has a certain chance of harvesting several potatoes at once.

Potato_Description.chinese: 一种栽种范围很广的块茎植物。

PowdermelonSeeds_Description.chinese: 冬天生长的特殊瓜类，7 天成熟。
PowdermelonSeeds_Description.english: A special melon that grows in winter; matures in 7 days.

Powdermelon_Description.chinese: 因表面结一层白霜而得名，瓜肉鲜脆清甜。
Powdermelon_Description.english: Named for the layer of white frost on its surface; its flesh is crisp and sweet.

PrehistoricHandaxe_Description.chinese: 人类最早的工具之一。用两块石头互相撞击以形成锋利的边缘，这种"粗糙的"工具就是这样造出来的。
PrehistoricHandaxe_Description.english: One of humanity's earliest tools. Strike two stones against each other to form a sharp edge; that is how this "crude" tool was made.

PrehistoricRib_Description.chinese: 肋骨一侧的浅沟说明这根肋骨曾经是什么人的晚餐。
PrehistoricRib_Description.english: The shallow grooves on one side of the rib show that it was once someone's dinner.

PrehistoricScapula_Description.chinese: 一般都被说成是“肩部刀刃”……无法确定这是什么生物的骨头。
PrehistoricScapula_Description.english: Usually called a "shoulder blade"... It can't be determined what creature's bone this is.

PrehistoricSkull_Description.chinese: 这绝对是一个哺乳类动物的头盖骨。
PrehistoricSkull_Description.english: This is definitely a mammal's skull.

PrehistoricTool_Description.chinese: 某种粗糙古老的挖掘工具。
PrehistoricTool_Description.english: Some kind of crude old digging tool.

PrehistoricVertebra_Description.chinese: 某个史前生物脊椎的一部分。
PrehistoricVertebra_Description.english: Part of some prehistoric creature's spine.

PressureNozzle_Description.chinese: 安装在洒水器上，增加灌溉范围。
PressureNozzle_Description.english: Fit on a sprinkler to increase its watering range.

PrismaticJelly_Description.chinese: 稀有且容易逃跑的五彩史莱姆会掉落。
PrismaticJelly_Description.english: Dropped by the rare and elusive prismatic slime.

PrismaticShard_Description.chinese: 一种来源未知的超稀有强力材料。
PrismaticShard_Description.english: An ultra-rare, powerful material of unknown origin.

PrizeTicket_Description.chinese: 在刘易斯家的兑奖机领取特殊奖励。
PrizeTicket_Description.english: Claim a special reward at the prize machine in Lewis's house.

ProtectionRing_Description.chinese: 在受到伤害后，保持一定时间的无敌状态。
ProtectionRing_Description.english: After taking damage, stay invincible for a certain time.

PumpkinPie_Description.chinese: 古怪的脆皮里面有丝滑的南瓜酱。
PumpkinPie_Description.english: Inside the quirky flaky crust is smooth pumpkin cream.

PumpkinSeeds_Description.english: Sow in autumn. Matures in 13 days.

Pumpkin_Description.chinese: 秋天的农作物，因为它香脆的种子以及甜美的果肉而深受喜爱。而且，南瓜壳还能用做节日饰品。
Pumpkin_Description.english: An autumn crop, much loved for its crunchy seeds and sweet flesh. And the pumpkin shell can be used as a festival decoration.

PurpleBook_Description.chinese: 阅读即可获得所有技能的经验。
PurpleBook_Description.english: Read it to gain experience in every skill.

PurpleMushroom_Description.chinese: 一种在山洞深处的稀有蘑菇。
PurpleMushroom_Description.english: A rare mushroom deep in caves.

PurpleSlimeEgg_Description.chinese: 可以在史莱姆孵化器中孵化。
PurpleSlimeEgg_Description.english: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.

QiBean_Description.chinese: 所有季节都可以种植。每天浇水可以产出齐瓜。4 天成熟。
QiBean_Description.english: Can be planted in any season. Water it every day to produce a Qi melon. Matures in 4 days.

QiFruit_Description.chinese: 齐先生要求你售出 500 个这种奇怪的瓜。
QiFruit_Description.english: Mr. Qi asks you to sell 500 of these strange melons.

QiSeasoning_Description.chinese: 只要一点点，就能让任何食物变成珍馐美馔。在烹饪过程中自动添加。
QiSeasoning_Description.english: Just a little turns any food into a gourmet feast. Added automatically during cooking.

QualityBobber_Description.chinese: 提高你钓到的鱼的品质。
QualityBobber_Description.english: Raises the quality of the fish you catch.

QualityFertilizer_Description.chinese: 提高土壤品质，增加你种出高品质作物的可能性。使用时加到犁过的土地中。
QualityFertilizer_Description.english: Improves soil quality, increasing your chance of growing high-quality crops. Mix into plowed soil when used.

QualityRetainingSoil_Description.chinese: 这种土壤有很大几率隔夜依然保持湿润。使用时加到犁过的土地中。
QualityRetainingSoil_Description.english: This soil has a big chance of staying moist overnight. Mix into plowed soil when used.

QualitySprinkler_Description.chinese: 每天早晨灌溉临近的 8 个地块。
QualitySprinkler_Description.english: Waters the 8 adjacent plots every morning.

Quartz_Description.chinese: 一种常见于洞穴和矿井里的纯净晶体。
Quartz_Description.english: A pure crystal commonly found in caves and mines.

RabbitsFoot_Description.english: Some people say it brings good luck.

RadioactiveBar_Description.chinese: 祖祖城安委会已知它会对人体造成不可逆的伤害。
RadioactiveBar_Description.english: The Zuzu City safety committee knows it causes irreversible harm to the human body.

RadioactiveCarp_Description.chinese: 在有毒淤泥里待了很多年的鲤鱼。
RadioactiveCarp_Description.english: A carp that has stayed many years in toxic sludge.

RadioactiveOre_Description.chinese: 它散发出危险的能量……可以熔炼成矿锭。
RadioactiveOre_Description.english: It gives off dangerous energy... can be smelted into ingots.

RadishSalad_Description.english: The radishes are really so crisp!

RadishSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer. Matures in 6 days.

Radish_Description.chinese: 新鲜清爽的块茎蔬菜，生吃的时候加一点胡椒。
Radish_Description.english: A fresh, crisp root vegetable; add a little pepper when eating it raw.

RainTotem_Description.chinese: 激活后，大大增加明天下雨的概率。消耗品。
RainTotem_Description.english: When activated, greatly increases the chance of rain tomorrow. Consumable.

RainbowShell_Description.chinese: 它是个非常美丽的贝壳。

RainbowTrout_Description.chinese: 一种身上有彩虹带的淡水鳟鱼。
RainbowTrout_Description.english: A freshwater trout with rainbow bands on its body.

Raisins_Description.chinese: 据说是祝尼魔最喜欢的食物。
Raisins_Description.english: Said to be the Junimos' favorite food.

RareDisc_Description.chinese: 一个镶着奇异红石头的厚重黑色圆盘。当你握住它的时候，恐惧漫上了心头。
RareDisc_Description.english: A heavy black disc set with strange red stones. When you hold it, dread wells up in your heart.

RareSeed_Description.chinese: 秋天播种。需要一个季度生长。
RareSeed_Description.english: Sow in autumn. Needs a whole season to grow.

RedCabbageSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer. Matures in 9 days.

RedCabbage_Description.chinese: 常用来做沙拉或者凉拌卷心菜。由于土地条件不同，颜色可能是紫色或者蓝色或者黄绿色。
RedCabbage_Description.english: Often used in salads or coleslaw. Depending on soil conditions, the color may be purple, blue or yellow-green.

RedMullet_Description.chinese: 从前它们被当做宠物饲养。
RedMullet_Description.english: Long ago they were kept as pets.

RedMushroom_Description.chinese: 这种斑点蘑菇偶尔出现在山洞中。
RedMushroom_Description.english: This spotted mushroom occasionally appears in caves.

RedSlimeEgg_Description.chinese: 可以在史莱姆孵化器中孵化。
RedSlimeEgg_Description.english: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.

RedSnapper_Description.chinese: 一种身上是漂亮红色的受欢迎鱼类。
RedSnapper_Description.english: A popular fish with a pretty red body.

RhubarbSeeds_Description.english: Sow in spring. Matures in 13 days.

Rhubarb_Description.chinese: 根茎极酸，但是加糖后是一种美味的甜品。
Rhubarb_Description.english: The stalks are extremely sour, but with sugar added they make a delicious dessert.

RicePudding_Description.chinese: 有浓郁的奶油，又甜，并且吃起来也很有意思。
RicePudding_Description.english: Rich and creamy, sweet, and fun to eat too.

RiceShoot_Description.chinese: 春天下种。8 天成熟。如果种植在水体附近，生长会更快。用镰刀收获。
RiceShoot_Description.english: Sow in spring. Matures in 8 days. If planted near water, it grows faster. Harvest with a scythe.

Rice_Description.chinese: 基本的粮食，可以配菜食用。
Rice_Description.english: A basic grain, can be eaten with dishes.

RingofYoba_Description.chinese: 偶尔为佩戴者抵挡伤害。
RingofYoba_Description.english: Occasionally blocks damage for the wearer.

RiverJelly_Description.chinese: 存在于淡水里的罕见凝胶。
RiverJelly_Description.english: A rare jelly found in fresh water.

RoastedHazelnuts_Description.chinese: 烤制工序使香味格外浓郁。
RoastedHazelnuts_Description.english: The roasting process makes the aroma especially rich.

Roe_Description.chinese: 新鲜的鱼卵。可以把它们在一个罐头瓶中腌制，从而产生特殊风味。
Roe_Description.english: Fresh fish eggs. You can cure them in a canning jar to bring out a special flavor.

RootsPlatter_Description.chinese: 让人食指大动，停不下来。
RootsPlatter_Description.english: Makes your mouth water; you can't stop.

RottenPlant_Description.chinese: 分解有机物质。黏稠且还不好闻。
RottenPlant_Description.english: Decomposing organic matter. Slimy and also smells bad.

Ruby_Description.chinese: 一种因其浓艳的颜色和美丽的光泽受人追捧的珍贵宝石。
Ruby_Description.english: A precious gem sought after for its intense color and beautiful luster.

RusticPlankFloor_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
RusticPlankFloor_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

RustyCog_Description.chinese: 一个保存完好的齿轮，它一定是某个古代机器的一部分。这可能是矮人工艺出品。
RustyCog_Description.english: A well-preserved gear; it must have been part of some ancient machine. It could be a product of dwarf craftsmanship.

RustySpoon_Description.chinese: 一个普通的旧汤匙，大概有 10 年之久了。没什么意思。
RustySpoon_Description.english: An ordinary old spoon, about 10 years old. Nothing interesting.

RustySpur_Description.chinese: 曾经连在某个牛仔靴子上的旧靴刺。肯定已经有好几代的人在此饲养动物了。
RustySpur_Description.english: An old spur once attached to some cowboy's boot. People must have been raising animals here for several generations.

SalmonDinner_Description.chinese: 柠檬汁给它增添了特别的味道。
SalmonDinner_Description.english: Lemon juice adds a special taste to it.

Salmonberry_Description.chinese: 一种带有森林的味道的春天浆果。
Salmonberry_Description.english: A spring berry with a taste of the forest.

Sandstone_Description.chinese: 一种常见的石头，有着红色和棕色的辉纹。
Sandstone_Description.english: A common stone, with red and brown streaks.

Sashimi_Description.english: Raw fish cut into thin slices.

SavageRing_Description.chinese: 当你杀死一个怪物后获得一点加速。
SavageRing_Description.english: Get a little speed boost after you kill a monster.

ScorpionCarp_Description.chinese: 它和普通的鲤鱼很像，但是它有锋利的毒刺。
ScorpionCarp_Description.english: It looks a lot like an ordinary carp, but it has a sharp venomous stinger.

SeaCucumber_Description.chinese: 一种在海底能找到的黏滑生物。
SeaCucumber_Description.english: A slimy, slippery creature found on the sea floor.

SeaJelly_Description.chinese: 存在于海里的罕见凝胶。
SeaJelly_Description.english: A rare jelly found in the sea.

SeaUrchin_Description.chinese: 一种动作缓慢的带刺生物，一些人把它们当作佳肴。
SeaUrchin_Description.english: A slow-moving spiny creature; some people treat them as a delicacy.

SeafoamPudding_Description.chinese: 这种咸布丁真的会让你感受到大海的气息！
SeafoamPudding_Description.english: This salty pudding will really let you feel the breath of the sea!

Seaweed_Description.english: It can be used in cooking.

SecretNote_Description.chinese: 虽然古老且皱皱巴巴，但是如果你仔细观察，你方能弄清细节……
SecretNote_Description.english: Although old and crumpled, if you look carefully, you can make out the details...

Shad_Description.chinese: 结群生活在海里，但会回到河里产卵。
Shad_Description.english: Lives in schools in the sea, but returns to rivers to spawn.

ShrimpCocktail_Description.chinese: 用新鲜捕获的虾制成的豪华开胃菜。
ShrimpCocktail_Description.english: A luxurious appetizer made with freshly caught shrimp.

Shrimp_Description.chinese: 在海洋地层觅食的清道夫。其肉广为人们喜爱。
Shrimp_Description.english: A scavenger that forages on the ocean floor. Its meat is widely loved.

SkeletalHand_Description.chinese: 这些史前遗迹能够存在这么久真是个奇迹。
SkeletalHand_Description.english: It's truly a miracle these prehistoric remains could last so long.

SkillBook0_Description.chinese: 阅读即可获得耕种经验。
SkillBook0_Description.english: Read it to gain farming experience.

SkillBook1_Description.chinese: 阅读即可获得钓鱼经验。
SkillBook1_Description.english: Read it to gain fishing experience.

SkillBook2_Description.chinese: 阅读即可获得采集经验。
SkillBook2_Description.english: Read it to gain foraging experience.

SkillBook3_Description.chinese: 阅读即可获得采矿经验。
SkillBook3_Description.english: Read it to gain mining experience.

SkillBook4_Description.chinese: 阅读即可获得战斗经验。
SkillBook4_Description.english: Read it to gain combat experience.

Slate_Description.chinese: 一种火山岩，当岩浆极速冷却时就会形成。
Slate_Description.english: A volcanic rock that forms when magma cools extremely fast.

SlimeCrate_Description.chinese: 可以用来将一只家养的史莱姆转移到其他地方。
SlimeCrate_Description.english: Can be used to move a domesticated slime somewhere else.

Slime_Description.chinese: 没有气味、发着微光的一团凝胶。
Slime_Description.english: A glimmering blob of jelly with no smell.

Slimejack_Description.chinese: 它身上裹了厚厚一层粘液，拿在手里总是要滑脱！
Slimejack_Description.english: Its body is coated with a thick layer of slime; it keeps slipping out of your hand!

SmallGlowRing_Description.chinese: 发出微小而又恒定的光。
SmallGlowRing_Description.english: Gives off a small, steady light.

SmallMagnetRing_Description.chinese: 些许增加你收集物品的半径。

SmallmouthBass_Description.chinese: 一种对污染很敏感的淡水鱼。
SmallmouthBass_Description.english: A freshwater fish very sensitive to pollution.

SmokedFish_CollectionsTabDescription.chinese: 一整条鱼，烟熏风味恰到好处。
SmokedFish_CollectionsTabDescription.english: A whole fish, with smoked flavor just right.

SmokedFish_Description.chinese: 一整条{0}，烟熏风味恰到好处。
SmokedFish_Description.english: A whole {0}, with smoked flavor just right.

Snail_Description.chinese: 一种分布很广、居住在螺纹外壳中的软体生物。
Snail_Description.english: A widely distributed mollusk that lives in a spiral shell.

SnakeSkull_Description.chinese: 一个保存完好的蛇头骨。

SnakeVertebrae_Description.english: This snake seems to have been very flexible.

SnowYam_Description.chinese: 这种小山药隐藏在雪地下。
SnowYam_Description.english: This little yam hides under the snow.

Soapstone_Description.chinese: 因为它质地比较柔软，很适合用来雕刻。
Soapstone_Description.english: Because its texture is fairly soft, it's very suitable for carving.

SolarEssence_Description.chinese: 发光的表面摸起来很温暖。
SolarEssence_Description.english: The glowing surface feels warm to the touch.

SonarBobber_Description.chinese: 在钓到鱼之前显示上钩的鱼种。
SonarBobber_Description.english: Shows which fish is on the hook before you catch it.

SonofCrimsonfish_Description.chinese: 它在温暖的夏水中孵化而出，追随父亲的足迹。
SonofCrimsonfish_Description.english: It hatched in the warm summer water, and follows in its father's footsteps.

SoulSapperRing_Description.chinese: 每次杀死一个怪物，都会获得一点能量。
SoulSapperRing_Description.english: Each time you kill a monster, you gain a little energy.

SpangleSeeds_Description.chinese: 夏天下种。8 天产出夺目的热带花朵。多种颜色。
SpangleSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer. Produces eye-catching tropical flowers in 8 days. Many colors.

SpecialCharmDescription.chinese: 你收到了{0}！你会感觉到有福气光环环绕着自己（运气永久增加）！
SpecialCharmDescription.english: You received {0}! You feel an aura of good fortune surrounding you (luck permanently increased)!

SpeedGro_Description.chinese: 促进叶子生长。保证能让植物的生长速度加快 10%。使用时加到犁过的土地中。
SpeedGro_Description.english: Stimulates leaf growth. Guaranteed to make plants grow 10% faster. Mix into plowed soil when used.

SpiceBerry_Description.chinese: 让空气中满满都是芬香的香味。
SpiceBerry_Description.english: Fills the air with a fragrant aroma.

Spinner_Description.chinese: 它的形状会使它在水中打转。稍稍提升钓鱼时的上钩率。
Spinner_Description.english: Its shape makes it spin in the water. Slightly raises the bite rate when fishing.

SpiritTorch_Description.chinese: 不清楚这些蓝色的亮光是从哪来的……
SpiritTorch_Description.english: It's unclear where this blue light comes from...

SpookFish_Description.chinese: 巨大的眼睛可以检测到猎物微弱的侧影。
SpookFish_Description.english: Its huge eyes can detect the faint silhouettes of prey.

Sprinkler_Description.chinese: 每天早上给四块邻近的土地浇水。
Sprinkler_Description.english: Waters four neighboring plots every morning.

SquidInk_Description.chinese: 鱿鱼使用这种墨汁来迷惑掠食者。
SquidInk_Description.english: Squid use this ink to confuse predators.

Squid_Description.chinese: 一种可以长得很大的深海生物。
Squid_Description.english: A deep-sea creature that can grow very large.

StarShards_Description.chinese: 没有人知道它们拼起来是什么样子。有些科学家声称它们的分子架构不符合以往的自然规律。
StarShards_Description.english: No one knows what they look like pieced together. Some scientists claim their molecular structure doesn't match any known natural law.

StardewValleyRose_Description.chinese: 会让你想起星露谷的玫瑰。香气令人愉悦。
StardewValleyRose_Description.english: Makes you think of Stardew Valley's roses. The fragrance is delightful.

StardropTea_Description.chinese: 非常特别的礼物，所有人都喜爱。
StardropTea_Description.english: A very special gift everyone loves.

Stardrop_Description.chinese: 一种神秘莫测的水果，给予食用者力量。它有梦幻般的味道……给人留下十分强烈的回忆，然而只可意会不可言传。
Stardrop_Description.english: A mysterious, unfathomable fruit that gives strength to whoever eats it. It has a dreamlike taste... leaving a very strong memory, yet one that can only be sensed, not put into words.

StarfruitSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer. Matures in 13 days.

Starfruit_Description.chinese: 美味多汁的热带水果。稍甜，夹着酸味。
Starfruit_Description.english: A delicious, juicy tropical fruit. Slightly sweet, with a hint of sourness.

SteppingStonePath_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
SteppingStonePath_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

Stingray_Description.chinese: 虽然有毒刺，但这种鱼很害羞，喜欢避开人类。
Stingray_Description.english: Although it has a venomous stinger, this fish is very shy and likes to avoid humans.

StoneBase_Description.english: A simple block made of stone.

StoneFence_Description.english: More durable than a wooden fence.

StoneFloor_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
StoneFloor_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

StoneWalkwayFloor_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
StoneWalkwayFloor_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

Stone_Description.chinese: 一种常见的材料，在加工和建筑中有很广泛的用途。
Stone_Description.english: A common material, widely used in crafting and building.

Stonefish_Description.chinese: 一种形状像砖块的奇怪鱼类。
Stonefish_Description.english: A strange fish shaped like a brick.

StrawFloor_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
StrawFloor_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

StrawberrySeeds_Description.chinese: 春天下种。8 天成熟，之后循环生产。
StrawberrySeeds_Description.english: Sow in spring. Matures in 8 days, then keeps producing.

Stuffing_Description.chinese: 啊……热面包和鼠尾草的香味。
Stuffing_Description.english: Ah... the smell of warm bread and sage.

SturdyRing_Description.chinese: 减少负状态影响持续时间的一半。
SturdyRing_Description.english: Cuts the duration of negative statuses in half.

Sturgeon_Description.chinese: 古老的生物链底层生物，数量一直在减少。雌性的寿命长达 150 年。
Sturgeon_Description.english: An ancient bottom-of-the-food-chain creature whose numbers keep falling. Females live as long as 150 years.

Sugar_Description.chinese: 加入面团中可以使小点心更加酥甜。吃多了对健康无益。
Sugar_Description.english: Added to dough, it makes pastries crisper and sweeter. Eating too much is bad for your health.

SummerSpangle_Description.chinese: 一种热带花朵，生长于潮湿的夏日季节。拥有芬香刺鼻的味道。
SummerSpangle_Description.english: A tropical flower that grows in the humid summer season. Has a fragrant, pungent smell.

SummerSquashSeeds_Description.chinese: 夏天播种，6 天长成，收获之后还能继续结果。
SummerSquashSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer; grows in 6 days, and keeps bearing fruit after harvest.

SummerSquash_Description.chinese: 未成熟时收获的金皮西葫芦嫩瓜。
SummerSquash_Description.english: Tender golden zucchini harvested before maturity.

SunflowerSeeds_Description.chinese: 夏天或秋天播种。8 天产出巨大向日葵。收割时产出更多种子。
SunflowerSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer or autumn. Produces a huge sunflower in 8 days. Produces more seeds when harvested.

Sunflower_Description.chinese: 一直被误会为向着太阳转动。
Sunflower_Description.english: Always misunderstood as turning toward the sun.

SuperCucumber_Description.chinese: 一种稀有紫色品种的海参。
SuperCucumber_Description.english: A rare purple variety of sea cucumber.

SuperMeal_Description.english: Truly a meal full of energy.

SweetGemBerry_Description.chinese: 它远比你尝过的任何东西都甜。
SweetGemBerry_Description.english: It's far sweeter than anything you've ever tasted.

TaroRoot_Description.chinese: 这种根茎富含淀粉，是最古老的农作物之一。
TaroRoot_Description.english: This root is rich in starch; one of the oldest crops.

TaroTuber_Description.chinese: 在温暖的天气里种下去。10 天成熟。种植在靠近水域的地方生长得更快。
TaroTuber_Description.english: Plant in warm weather. Matures in 10 days. Grows faster when planted close to water.

TeaLeaves_Description.chinese: 茶树幼叶。可冲泡成受人欢迎的提神茶水。
TeaLeaves_Description.english: Young leaves of the tea plant. Can be brewed into popular refreshing tea.

TeaSapling_Description.chinese: 需要 20 天才能成熟。在每个季节的最后一周产出茶叶，冬季除外。无需浇水！
TeaSapling_Description.english: Needs 20 days to mature. Produces tea leaves in the last week of every season, except winter. No need to water!

TentKit_Description.chinese: 可以放置一顶一次性帐篷用来睡觉，只能在户外使用。
TentKit_Description.english: Can put up a one-use tent for sleeping; can only be used outdoors.

ThornsRing_Description.chinese: 当敌人对你造成伤害时，他们也将受到伤害。
ThornsRing_Description.english: When enemies hurt you, they will also take damage.

ThunderEgg_Description.chinese: 根据传说，愤怒的雷霆神灵会朝彼此扔这些石头。
ThunderEgg_Description.english: According to legend, angry thunder spirits throw these stones at each other.

TigerSlimeEgg_Description.chinese: 可以在史莱姆孵化器中孵化。使用时请额外小心！
TigerSlimeEgg_Description.english: Can be hatched in a slime incubator. Please take extra care when using it!

TigerTrout_Description.chinese: 一种不能繁殖后代的稀有杂交鳟鱼。
TigerTrout_Description.english: A rare hybrid trout that can't reproduce.

Tigerseye_Description.chinese: 它上面的金色的条纹使这块宝石拥有了温暖的光泽。
Tigerseye_Description.english: The gold stripes on it give this gem a warm luster.

Tilapia_Description.chinese: 一种主要食素、喜爱温水的鱼。
Tilapia_Description.english: A mainly vegetarian fish that loves warm water.

TomatoSeeds_Description.chinese: 夏天播种。11 天成熟，收获之后还能继续结果。
TomatoSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer. Matures in 11 days, and keeps bearing fruit after harvest.

Tomato_Description.chinese: 口感丰富，味道略有些强烈。西红柿有非常广泛的烹饪用途。
Tomato_Description.english: Rich in texture, the taste slightly strong. Tomatoes have very wide culinary uses.

TopazRing_Description.chinese: 戴着这个会感觉安全一点点。
TopazRing_Description.english: Wearing this you'll feel a tiny bit safer.

Topaz_Description.chinese: 很常见，但是因为漂亮还是很有价值。
Topaz_Description.english: Very common, but still valuable because it's pretty.

Tortilla_Description.chinese: 可以用来盛食物，也可以直接吃。
Tortilla_Description.english: Can hold food, or can be eaten on its own.

TrapBobber_Description.chinese: 让你没在拉钩的时候，鱼会逃跑的慢一些。
TrapBobber_Description.english: When you aren't reeling in, fish escape a bit more slowly.

TreasureChest_Description.chinese: 哇，里面塞满了财宝！肯定能卖个好价钱。
TreasureChest_Description.english: Wow, it's stuffed with treasure! It can surely sell for a good price.

TreasureHunter_Description.chinese: 在收集宝藏的时候鱼是不会逃走的。并且它能够稍微增加找到宝藏的几率。
TreasureHunter_Description.english: While collecting treasure, fish won't escape. And it slightly increases the chance of finding treasure.

TreasureTotem_Description.chinese: 在可挖掘的地形上使用即可召唤一圈宝藏挖掘点。
TreasureTotem_Description.english: Use on diggable terrain to summon a ring of treasure digging spots.

TreeFertilizer_Description.chinese: 洒在野树上，使其快速生长，冬天也一样。在果树上不起作用。
TreeFertilizer_Description.english: Sprinkle on a wild tree to make it grow fast, even in winter. Doesn't work on fruit trees.

Trilobite_Description.chinese: 一种早已灭绝的生物，和螃蟹有亲缘关系。
Trilobite_Description.english: A long-extinct creature related to the crab.

TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Description.chinese: 镶了金边的紫色丝织短裤……
TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Description.english: Purple silk shorts trimmed with gold...

TripleShotEspresso_Description.english: It's more effective than ordinary coffee!

TropicalCurry_Description.chinese: 盛在菠萝碗里的别具异国风味的咖喱。
TropicalCurry_Description.english: An exotic-flavored curry served in a pineapple bowl.

TroutDerbyTag_Description.chinese: 交给鳟鱼大赛摊位即可获得奖励。
TroutDerbyTag_Description.english: Hand it in at the trout contest booth for a reward.

TruffleOil_Description.english: An essential ingredient for fine dishes.

Truffle_Description.chinese: 一种味道极佳的菌类，有着独特的风味。
Truffle_Description.english: A fungus of excellent taste, with a unique flavor.

TulipBulb_Description.chinese: 春天下种。6 天产出鲜艳花朵。多种颜色。
TulipBulb_Description.english: Sow in spring. Produces bright flowers in 6 days. Many colors.

Tulip_Description.chinese: 最受欢迎的春天花朵。淡淡的芳香味。
Tulip_Description.english: The most popular spring flower. A light, faint fragrance.

Tuna_Description.chinese: 一种住在海里的大型鱼。
Tuna_Description.english: A large fish that lives in the sea.

UnmilledRice_Description.chinese: 大米以未加工的形式。通过磨机运行以增加价值。
UnmilledRice_Description.english: Rice in unprocessed form. Run it through a mill to increase its value.

VampireRing_Description.chinese: 每次杀死一个怪物后获得一点生命值。
VampireRing_Description.english: Gain a little health every time you kill a monster.

Vinegar_Description.chinese: 酿造过的酸性液体，许多配方中都会用到。
Vinegar_Description.english: A brewed sour liquid, used in many recipes.

VoidEgg_Description.chinese: 有红色斑点的黝黑的蛋。摸起来热热的。
VoidEgg_Description.english: A jet-black egg with red spots. It feels hot to the touch.

VoidEssence_Description.chinese: 黑暗能量在其中涌动着。

VoidGhostPendant_Description.chinese: 它对影子人有重要象征意义。拿它送礼，就代表想要交朋友并住在一起。
VoidGhostPendant_Description.english: It has an important symbolic meaning to the shadow people. Giving it as a gift means wanting to be friends and live together.

VoidMayonnaise_Description.chinese: 粘稠、膏状，闻起来像烧焦的头发。
VoidMayonnaise_Description.english: Thick and paste-like, it smells like burnt hair.

VoidSalmon_Description.chinese: 一条鲑鱼，被虚空力量所扭曲。新鲜的肉是墨黑色的，但当暴露于空气中时很快变成粉红色的了。
VoidSalmon_Description.english: A salmon, twisted by the power of the void. The fresh meat is ink-black, but quickly turns pink when exposed to air.

VolcanoGoldNode_Description.english: Break it open to get gold ore.

Walleye_Description.chinese: 一种在夜间捕捉的淡水鱼。
Walleye_Description.english: A freshwater fish caught at night.

WarMemento_Description.chinese: 这是一张褪色的士兵照片……
WarMemento_Description.english: This is a faded photo of a soldier...

WarpTotemBeach_Description.chinese: 直接将你传送到海滩。消耗品。
WarpTotemBeach_Description.english: Teleports you directly to the beach. Consumable.

WarpTotemDesert_Description.chinese: 直接将你传送到卡利科沙漠。消耗品。
WarpTotemDesert_Description.english: Teleports you directly to the Calico Desert. Consumable.

WarpTotemFarm_Description.chinese: 直接将你传送到农场。消耗品。
WarpTotemFarm_Description.english: Teleports you directly to the farm. Consumable.

WarpTotemIsland_Description.chinese: 直接将你传送到姜岛。消耗品。
WarpTotemIsland_Description.english: Teleports you directly to Ginger Island. Consumable.

WarpTotemMountains_Description.chinese: 直接将你传送到山岭。消耗品。
WarpTotemMountains_Description.english: Teleports you directly to the mountains. Consumable.

WarpTotemQisArena_Description.chinese: 传送到齐先生的场地。做好准备迎接挑战！
WarpTotemQisArena_Description.english: Teleport to Mr. Qi's arena. Get ready to take on the challenge!

WarpTotemQisArena_Name.chinese: 传送图腾：齐先生的场地

WarriorRing_Description.chinese: 在杀死怪物后，偶尔输送“战士能量”给佩戴者。
WarriorRing_Description.english: After you kill monsters, occasionally channels "warrior energy" to the wearer.

WeatheredFloor_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
WeatheredFloor_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

WeddingRing_Description.chinese: 祖祖城的古老传统……用来向另一位农夫求婚。
WeddingRing_Description.english: An old Zuzu City tradition... used to propose to another farmer.

Weeds_Description.english: A bunch of annoying wild grass.

Weeds_DryBush_Description.chinese: 一簇干燥、老灌木丛。 Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
Weeds_DryBush_Description.english: A cluster of dry old bushes. (English: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.)

segments.text: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
segments.pinyin: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds

Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Ugly_Description.chinese: 一束令人讨厌的野草。 Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Ugly_Description.english: A bunch of annoying wild grass. (English: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.)

segments.text: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
segments.pinyin: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds

Weeds_Fiber_Ugly_Description.chinese: 一束令人讨厌的野草。 Cut to obtain wild seeds.
Weeds_Fiber_Ugly_Description.english: A bunch of annoying wild grass. (English: Cut to obtain wild seeds.)

WheatFlour_Description.chinese: 碾碎麦粒后得到的普通食材。
WheatFlour_Description.english: A common ingredient obtained by grinding wheat grains.

WheatSeeds_Description.chinese: 夏天或秋天播种。4 天成熟。用镰刀收获。
WheatSeeds_Description.english: Sow in summer or autumn. Matures in 4 days. Harvest with a scythe.

Wheat_Description.chinese: 被广泛种植的谷物之一。能做成制作蛋糕和面包的上好面粉。
Wheat_Description.english: One of the widely grown grains. Can be made into fine flour for cakes and bread.

WildBait_Description.chinese: 用莱纳斯的独特配方制作，有机会一次钓到两条鱼。
WildBait_Description.english: Made with Linus's unique recipe; has a chance to catch two fish at once.

WildHorseradish_Description.chinese: 春天生长的一种根茎香料。
WildHorseradish_Description.english: A root spice that grows in spring.

WildPlum_Description.english: Sweet and sour and juicy, with a strong aroma.

WiltedBouquet_Description.chinese: 表示你不想再和某人约会的礼物。
WiltedBouquet_Description.english: A gift meaning you don't want to date someone any more.

WoodFence_Description.chinese: 让小草以及动物呆在里面！

WoodFloor_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
WoodFloor_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

WoodPath_Description.chinese: 放在地上修建小路，也可以装饰地板。
WoodPath_Description.english: Put on the ground to build paths, or to decorate floors.

Wood_Description.chinese: 结实而有韧性的植物材料，有非常广泛的用途。
Wood_Description.english: Sturdy yet flexible plant material, with a very wide range of uses.

Woodskip_Description.chinese: 一种十分敏感的鱼，只能在森林深处的水池中生存。
Woodskip_Description.english: A very sensitive fish that can only survive in pools deep in the forest.

WrigglingWorm_Description.chinese: 一条湿漉漉的，还在蠕动的蚯蚓。
WrigglingWorm_Description.english: A wet worm that is still wriggling.

YamSeeds_Description.english: Sow in autumn. Matures in 10 days.

Yam_Description.chinese: 淀粉块茎植物，有很多食用方式。
Yam_Description.english: A starchy tuber, with many ways to eat it.
